items.title: Russia warns UK will pay for supplying drones to Ukraine
items.description: Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war after British-made drones were used, but the MoD says it stands against Russian aggression.

items.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
items.description: Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using sperm and egg donors which were not the ones selected by the parents.

items.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
items.description: After he was shot multiple times, Tupac Shakur refused to cooperate with police and told an officer "we'll take care of it", an officer testified.

items.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
items.description: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

items.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
items.description: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.

items.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
items.description: The alleged shooter, also a student, later took his own life.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
items.description: The former heavyweight boxing champion shares a child with the Heroes actress, who died on Sunday.
